history.majorEvents: Hospitalized 09/14/2026-09/22/2026 (Washington General Hospital, fake) for acute left MCA ischemic stroke; outside tPA window. Inpatient rehabilitation 09/22/2026-10/10/2026. Discharged home with son.
history.ongoingProblems: Right hemiparesis and expressive aphasia after stroke; atrial fibrillation on apixaban; hypertension; type 2 diabetes.
history.social: Widowed. Lives with son Marcus Bell (age 46), who is her primary caregiver and works full-time as an IT analyst. Retired school cafeteria worker. Never smoker, no alcohol.

encounters.chiefComplaint: Post-hospital follow-up after stroke; son requests FMLA and home care paperwork
encounters.subjective:
74 y/o F seen 4 days after discharge from inpatient rehab for left MCA ischemic stroke (09/14/2026). Accompanied by son Marcus, primary caregiver.
Persistent right-sided weakness and expressive aphasia. Uses hemi-walker in home and wheelchair for distances. Needs help bathing, dressing, toileting and transfers; feeds self after setup. Cannot manage medications, cooking, money or phone calls.
Son requests FMLA certification to care for her and a level-of-care request for the EPD waiver.
encounters.objective: Alert, follows 1-step commands. Expressive aphasia, short phrases. Right facial droop. RUE strength 2/5, RLE 3/5, left 5/5. Requires 1-person assist for sit-to-stand and transfers. Irregularly irregular rhythm.
encounters.assessment:
Left MCA ischemic stroke 09/14/2026 (I63.512) with right dominant hemiparesis (I69.351) and aphasia (I69.320).
Atrial fibrillation on anticoagulation (I48.91).
HTN (I10), T2DM (E11.9).
encounters.plan:
Home health PT, OT and speech therapy 3x/week for 8 weeks (10/15/2026-12/10/2026).
Requires 24-hour supervision and hands-on help with ADLs; son is providing care.
Son will need continuous leave from work 10/10/2026 through 12/31/2026, then intermittent leave to take her to appointments (about 2-3 per month, 1 day each) for the next 6 months.
Cardiology follow-up 11/05/2026; Neurology follow-up 11/18/2026.
Complete DHCF 1728 for EPD waiver; complete FMLA WH-380-F for son.

encounters.subjective:
Slow improvement with home therapy. Still requires extensive assistance with bathing, dressing and toileting. Walks short distances with hemi-walker and standby assistance of 1 person. Eats with setup and help cutting food.
Unable to manage medications, prepare meals, do housekeeping, manage money or use the telephone without help.
encounters.objective: RUE 2+/5, RLE 3+/5. Speech: expressive aphasia, improving. Not ventilator dependent.
encounters.assessment: Functional status: ADLs - bathing extensive, dressing extensive, overall mobility limited/supervision, eating limited/supervision, toilet use extensive. IADLs - medication management, meal preparation, housekeeping, money management, telephone: all extensive/total.
encounters.plan: Continue home therapy. Continue apixaban, atorvastatin, BP and diabetes regimen. Recheck 4 weeks.
